name: Steal the Painful Memory — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Steal the Painful Memory from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Steal the Painful Memory" but are not part of the Steal the Painful Memory entry, which is unchanged.

CASTING

Casting Time 1 hour
Components V, S, F (accurate written record of the event)

EFFECT

Range 1 mile/level
Target see text
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Sometimes information is best left unknown. Perhaps a village doesn’t want to remember a particularly horrible murder, or the shameful act of one of its members. In this case, a powerful spellcaster can use steal the painful memory to remove all recollection of the event from the minds of the community. Steal the painful memory allows you to strip away all memories of a particular event. You must be able to describe the event in approximately 12 words or less. For example, any of the following would work: “Forget that this creature ever existed” “Forget that this creature was murdered” or “Forget that this creature murdered this creature.” The gap in memory will be filled in by the simplest solution, and all people affected by the spell will share this memory. Told to forget a murder, they will believe that the victim moved away; told to forget the identity of the murderer, they will believe that the crime was never solved or that the unknown murderer escaped.
